Record what a build produced

Source: R/output_manifest.R
hf_output_manifest.Rd

Writes a manifest of finished products: the md5, size, layer counts and invariant verdict of each, together with the commit that built them and the digest of the input manifest they were built from. Verifiable with hf_verify_manifest(), the same way inputs are.

Usage

hf_output_manifest(
  gpkgs,
  out,
  input_manifest = NULL,
  git_sha = Sys.getenv("HF_GIT_SHA", "")
)

Arguments

gpkgs

Paths to the finished products.

out

Path to write the manifest JSON to.

input_manifest

Optional path to the input manifest used for the build; its md5 is recorded so the two can be tied together.

git_sha

Commit that produced the products. Defaults to HF_GIT_SHA.

Value

Invisibly, the manifest as a list. Written to out as JSON.

Details

This is the other half of hf_input_manifest(). Without it a product cannot be checked against what was shipped, and the tie between a delivered file, the code that made it and the inputs it consumed lives only in a build log.

The input manifest is recorded by digest rather than copied, so one line establishes which input set was used without duplicating it.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
hf_output_manifest(
  Sys.glob("global/*_ngen.gpkg"),
  out = "global/output_manifest.json",
  input_manifest = "owp-inputs/national_inputs_manifest.json")
} # }
